The real gap turned out to be exactly where the prior claim's own 'STILL NOT PORTED, honestly' note already pointed: finishPropellers (:1042-1081), whose FinishPropeller previously computed only the spin axis. Also fixed, inside the ALREADY-claimed spinPropellers (:1089-1123, previously documented 'PORTED VERBATIM'): SpinPropellers computed `bool visible = blur > 0.01f;` and never applied it to the real disc -- a dead local variable, found by the probe's new discLowRpm/discHighRpm cases (JS prints disc.visible toggling; the C# side had nothing to compare against until this line was wired to Renderer.enabled, not GameObject.SetActive, so the per-frame disc rotation just above it keeps running regardless of visibility exactly like THREE's own `.visible` flag leaves transform/children alone). One claimed finding did NOT hold up on measurement and is explicitly withdrawn here rather than silently dropped: a first read of hintedPropellers (:792-859) looked like its final `reachFrom(set, basis, h)` used the FIRST refinement's hub while the hub position used the SECOND (`c`) -- a plausible one-line bug. Left unchanged, now with a comment citing the empirical check.
